title_en: Nvidia Graphics Cards Are About to Get Even More Expensive, As the Company Reportedly Gets Ready to Raise Prices By as Much as 30%
cn_title: 传英伟达显卡最高涨价30%
subtitle: 内存危机加码
summary: 据台湾《经济日报》报道，为英伟达显卡供应内存芯片的三星已将DRAM价格上调20%，英伟达显卡或最高涨价30%。RTX5090自年初升至约5,000美元(约合人民币35900元)后未回落，Blackwell GPU产品线可能全面受波及。
opus_summary: 三星上调DRAM价格20%，英伟达显卡或最高涨价30%。RTX5090已升至约5000美元(约合人民币3万元)，这波可能波及Blackwell GPU。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia graphics cards aren't exactly known for being affordable right now, but it looks like Team Green's GPUs are about to get another price increase, thanks to the ongoing memory crisis .
paragraphs.cn: 英伟达显卡眼下本就谈不上便宜，但受持续内存危机影响，「绿队」的GPU看来又要迎来一次涨价。

paragraphs.en: According to a post on Taiwan's Economic Daily News , Samsung, which makes the memory chips Nvidia uses in its graphics cards , has raised DRAM prices by 20%. In response, the article claims that Nvidia is going to raise prices on its graphics cards by as much as 30%.
paragraphs.cn: 据台湾《经济日报》的一篇报道，负责制造英伟达显卡所用内存芯片的三星，已将DRAM价格上调20%。该报道声称，英伟达将把其显卡价格最高上调30%。

paragraphs.en: Keep in mind, though, that at this time, the price increases being reported on by UDN are supplier-side prices. That will filter down to retail, for sure, but we don't know by how much quite yet.
paragraphs.cn: 不过要注意，UDN目前报道的上涨是供应商端的价格。这必然会传导至零售端，但目前还不清楚具体幅度。

paragraphs.en: This wouldn't be the first time this year Nvidia has raised GPU prices. Back in February, the RTX 5090 went up to about $5000, and hasn't come down since. There was even a point where it looked like Team Green had discontinued the RTX 5070 Ti due to increased memory demand – luckily that didn't actually happen. If the 5090's price goes up by another 30%, the flagship GPU could go up to around $6500.
paragraphs.cn: 这已经不是英伟达今年第一次上调GPU价格了。今年2月，RTX5090的售价升至约5,000美元(约合人民币3万元)，此后一直没有回落。曾有一段时间，外界看来「绿队」似乎已因内存需求增加而停产RTX 5070 Ti——好在这并未成真。若5090再涨30%，这款旗舰GPU的价格可能升至约6,500美元(约合人民币4万元)。

paragraphs.en: However, the price increases that happened earlier this year were mostly confined to higher-end Nvidia graphics cards. This time around, it seems like the entire lineup of Blackwell GPUs will be affected. Right now, the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 , which launched for $549 back in February 2025, is going for about $650. If there is a flat 30% price increase, that mid-range GPU will likely go up to around $850.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，今年早些时候的价格上涨大多只波及英伟达的高端显卡。这一次，似乎整个Blackwell GPU产品线都会受影响。目前，NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070在2025年2月以549美元(约合人民币3717元)起售价推出，现在价格约为650美元(约合人民币4400元)。若统一涨价30%，这款中端GPU的价格很可能升至约850美元(约合人民币5754元)。

paragraphs.en: I've reached out to Nvidia for comment on these price increases, and I'll update this article if and when I hear back. Regardless, it shouldn't come as too much of a surprise that more GPU price increases are coming. After all, Valve told us earlier this month that the RAM crisis is only getting worse , and it seems like Microsoft is worried that further price increases are coming, too .
paragraphs.cn: 我已就这些涨价向英伟达寻求置评，如有回复，我会更新本文。不管怎样，显卡进一步涨价并不令人太意外。毕竟，Valve本月早些时候告诉我们，内存危机只会愈演愈烈；微软似乎也担心会有更多涨价。
